definitions.explanation: A long, slender sea eel. In Japanese cooking it is simmered and brushed with sweet sauce for sushi, or fried as tempura.

examples.japanese: {穴子|あなご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{天丼|てんどん}→天丼：19279_tendon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{穴子|あなご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There is conger eel tempura on the tempura rice bowl.

examples.japanese: {煮穴子|にあなご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦たれ→タレ：10500_tare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}って→塗る：01174_nuru⟧{握|にぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: Simmered conger eel is usually brushed with sweet sauce and served as nigiri.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鰻|うなぎ}→鰻：06105_unagi⟧: freshwater eel, richer and fattier, grilled as ⟦{蒲焼|かばや}き→蒲焼き：29221_kabayaki⟧. {穴子|あなご} lives in the sea and is lighter and softer; it is the cheaper, everyday eel at sushi bars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煮穴子|にあなご}: simmered conger eel
- {穴子|あなご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: conger eel tempura
- {穴子|あなご}{丼|どん}: conger eel rice bowl

WRITING:
Usually written {穴子|あなご}; アナゴ in katakana in biology and on some menus.
